payoutCycle.description: First payout can be requested 14 days after placing the first trade on a funded account.

warnings: Breaching maximum daily or overall drawdown rules will result in account termination.
Trading style policies and news restrictions apply depending on the chosen account evaluation model.

requirements: Execute at least 2 successful payout requests

faqs.question: How often can I request a payout with For Traders?
faqs.answer: Traders can request their first payout after 14 days of trading on a funded account. Subsequent payouts can be processed bi-weekly or on-demand depending on performance and withdrawal channel.

seo.title: For Traders Payout Frequency & Rules
seo.metaDescription: Learn about the payout schedule, minimum waiting period, and processing frequency for For Traders funded accounts.

faqs.question: What are the drawdown limits for For Traders accounts?
faqs.answer: For Traders enforces maximum daily drawdown and total maximum drawdown limits tailored to the evaluation model selected. Exceeding these drawdown thresholds results in account termination.

seo.title: For Traders Drawdown Rules & Maximum Limits
seo.metaDescription: Understand how maximum daily drawdown and total loss limits are calculated on For Traders challenge accounts.

faqs.question: Which payout methods are supported by For Traders?
faqs.answer: For Traders supports several payout methods including Cryptocurrency (USDT), Rise payroll/wallet service, and traditional Bank Wire transfers.

seo.title: Supported Payout Methods for For Traders
seo.metaDescription: Discover all available payout methods including Crypto USDT, Rise, and Bank Wire for requesting withdrawals at For Traders.

faqs.question: Is the evaluation fee refunded upon reaching funded status?
faqs.answer: Yes, your initial evaluation challenge fee is fully refunded alongside your first successful profit withdrawal from a funded account.

seo.title: For Traders Challenge Fee Refund Policy
seo.metaDescription: Find out when and how your initial challenge fee is refunded upon achieving your first payout with For Traders.
